rows.name: items
rows.description: The data to render, one card each.

rows.name: renderItem
rows.description: Render the card for one item — typically a <Card> with CardHeader / CardTitle / CardBody.

rows.name: getKey
rows.description: Stable React key for an item. Defaults to the array index.

rows.name: minColumnWidth
rows.description: Minimum column width before the responsive gallery wraps to the next row.

rows.name: emptyState
rows.description: Rendered instead of the grid when items is empty — e.g. a <StatusPanel variant="empty">.
